note: The COLLADA Name_array/IDREF_array count from the file controls how many string entries are stored for later indexed lookup.
The accessor stride from the file is preserved and later used to translate a logical index into a string-array position.
The loader assumes the computed position is within the string array; this safety obligation is the missing bound check for the accessor-derived index mapping.
An out-of-range string lookup is performed while assigning a bone name, which can read past the end of the string vector and trigger the reported stack-buffer-overflow read.
